excerpt: The survey explains that approximately half of optic nerve fibers are distributed in the fovea and the rest across the periphery, then describes foveated rendering as high-quality rendering in the foveal region and low-quality rendering in the peripheral region.
overview: This passage supplies the perceptual mechanism behind the acceleration claim. It connects retinal resource distribution to an engineering strategy: spend rendering work where the user can perceive fine detail and reduce work in peripheral regions where lower fidelity is less noticeable.
title: Fovea-Periphery Quality Allocation
